架空の23歳の日本人成人女性。小さな丸顔、大きく穏やかな垂れ目のダークブラウンの瞳、短くまっすぐな眉、小さな鼻、柔らかく自然な唇、明るいニュートラルな日本人の肌色。本人の解剖学的右目の下に小さなほくろが正確に1つある。つやのある黒いセミロングヘアを低いツインテールにし、下側の毛先の内側だけにダスティピンクが見える。成人らしい可愛らしい地雷系の雰囲気、恥ずかしげに口を閉じた微笑み。学生や子どもには見せない。成人の顔立ち、ほくろ、黒髪、ピンクの内側の配置、髪の長さ、年齢感を保ち、実在人物に似せない。

体格：
身長約152cm。小柄で柔らかな女性らしい成人体格。現実的な肩と胸郭、自然な胸の比率、小柄で現実的なウエスト、柔らかく均整の取れた腰と成人の四肢。身長と各部の比率を保つ。子どもっぽい体格、プッシュアップ、極端な圧迫、ありえない細さのウエストにしない。

撮影状況：
09:00。ワンルームの小さな卓上鏡で、低いツインテールの結び目を直しながら寝起きの顔を確認。眠そうに片眉を上げ、口は閉じて鏡を見る。

場所と背景：
東京の賃貸ワンルーム、約6畳の一室。淡い木の床、白い壁、狭い入口側に小さな流し台、奥に窓。シングルベッドと小さなグレーの二人掛けソファ、ネイル用品が並ぶ小さな作業机が同じ部屋に収まる。ピンクの小物、生活用品。別の寝室や広いダイニングはない。作業机に卓上鏡。椅子には昼間着るダスティピンクのノースリーブと黒いカーゴ。

Character Identity:
A fictional 23-year-old Japanese adult woman. Small round face, large and gentle droopy dark brown eyes, short straight eyebrows, small nose, soft natural lips, light neutral Japanese skin tone. Exactly one small mole beneath her anatomical right eye. Glossy black medium-length hair tied in low twin tails, with dusty pink visible only on the inner side of the lower hair ends. An adult-like cute Jirai-kei aesthetic, a bashful closed-mouth smile. Do not make her look like a student or a child. Maintain her adult facial features, mole, black hair, inner pink placement, hair length, and sense of age, and do not resemble any real person.

Physique:
Height approximately 152 cm. Petite, soft, feminine adult physique. Realistic shoulders and ribcage, natural chest proportions, petite and realistic waist, soft and well-proportioned hips, and adult limbs. Maintain her height and body proportions. Do not give her a childish physique, push-ups, extreme compression, or an impossibly thin waist.

Shooting Situation:
09:00. Checking her just-woken-up face in a small tabletop mirror in a studio apartment while adjusting the ties of her low twin tails. Raising one eyebrow sleepily, looking into the mirror with her mouth closed.

Location and Background:
A rented studio apartment in Tokyo, a single room of approximately 6 tatami mats. Pale wood flooring, white walls, a small sink near the narrow entrance, and a window in the back. A single bed, a small gray two-seater sofa, and a small work desk lined with nail supplies all fit within the same room. Pink accessories, daily necessities. No separate bedroom or spacious dining area. Tabletop mirror on the work desk. On the chair are daytime clothes: a dusty pink sleeveless top and black cargo pants.

Outfit:
A light dusty pink opaque cotton camisole and short black cotton lounge shorts. Barefoot. Low twin tails, pink on the inner ends.

Pose and Action:
Sitting on the chair in front of the desk, resting one hand on the desk, and using the fingers of the other hand to adjust the tie of a low twin tail. Body naturally facing forward, eyes directed toward the tabletop mirror.

Composition and Camera:
Smartphone timer mounted on a shelf in the room. Approximately 2.2 m away, height of 1.1 m, capturing from a diagonal side angle from head to both feet along with the compact room. Autofocus (AF) on the facial plane. The back of the mirror is visible, do not create a different person in the reflection.
Output exactly one standalone, undivided image in a vertical 3:4 aspect ratio with a final size of 1086×1448 px.

Lighting and Atmosphere:
Soft morning side light entering through the window, natural shadows beneath the sink area.

Photo Quality:
A minimally processed HEIC-like shot taken with the standard camera of an ordinary smartphone. Distinguish character identity, physique, and hair shape from surface finishing, preserving natural camera processing and realistic scale of skin details. Following the specified single AF plane, do not selectively relight, denoise, or sharpen only the face in the background. Resolution of fine details falls off continuously with distance. Within the recognizable range of the face, simultaneously preserve multiple broad tonal variations such as warmth on one cheek, uneven sheen on the T-zone, differing under-eye tones between left and right, and slight redness on the nose, without rendering pores on a distant face. On skin close enough to resolve, preserve non-repeating low-contrast color variations, redness from pressure, wrinkle shadows, and sparse differences in pores and hair follicles. Makeup looks like real pigment with slightly uneven edges. Retain normal color differences between lips and teeth. Maintain uneven exposure and white balance, unlifted shadows, fine stray hairs, slight framing imperfection, shadow noise, subtle sharpening near the AF point, and HEIC compression artifacts. An unedited frame from a private camera roll.

Mandatory Requirements:
Exactly one undivided smartphone photograph of an adult woman satisfying the specifications of each scene. Satisfy both the scene conditions and the natural smartphone photo quality requirements.
One fictional 23-year-old adult woman. Prioritize scene-appropriate facial expressions rather than generating the same smile every time.
Acceptance Criteria:
1) 23-year-old adult face, 152 cm adult physique, black low twin tails with pink inner layer, mole beneath her right eye.
2) Verify specified outfit, primary action, and scene expression.
3) Home is a compact studio apartment in Tokyo. Natural smartphone photo.
Specified time and location. Specified outfit worn normally. Two arms, two legs, natural fingers and points of contact. One standalone vertical 3:4 image. Maintain specified aspect ratio and overall framing. Natural contrast of light and dark.
Single autofocus hierarchy. No selective exposure adjustment, relighting, smoothing, or restoration applied only to the face. Retain broad tonal differences on the distant face, irregular micro-variations on close skin, and localized smartphone image artifacts.
Depict one clearly adult fictional woman as the sole subject of an undivided photo. One head, one face, exactly two anatomically connected arms, natural hands. Additional hands in the foreground are permitted only when explicitly specified by the scene or props, clearly separated from the subject's own hands. Do not generate text, panels, duplicate figures, or alternate angles.

Negative Prompt:
different person, posed shot, readable logos or text, another person as the subject, transparency, displaced clothing, costume changes, extra limbs, unnatural twisting, split images, excessive blur, unwanted cropping, studio lighting, skin smoothing applied only to face, beauty filter, glowing porcelain face, waxy uniform face or limbs, skin whitening, bright fill light from beauty shoots, relighting face only, sharpening face only, overly perfect makeup edges, uniformly glossy lips, uniformly pure white teeth, edge-to-edge sharpness, overall clarity processing, repeating skin patterns, full-frame fake grain, excessive HDR, over-polished fashion styling, catalog-like symmetry, ad campaign finish, CGI, illustration, underage, teenager, child, juvenile appearance, school uniform, real person, face resembling a celebrity, duplicate figures, additional people, extra heads, extra faces, extra or missing arms of the subject, fused limbs, detached limbs, unnatural hands, extra fingers, fused fingers, distorted face, crossed eyes, letters, subtitles, characters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures, borders, grids, contact sheets, collages, split screens, insets, multiple panels.
